::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 19th [1854]  
**From:** Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Historical Society of Pennsylvania: Gratz Collection: Case 10, Box 36. British Authors. Printed by Green, ['Two Popular Novelists'](other_books/otherbook_75.qmd).
:::

Dear [Sir](people/person_1143.qmd)
I am much obliged by your sending me the account of ‘[The Little Duke](cmy_books/cmybook_20.qmd)’ and the accompanying [£100](organizations/other_160.qmd). I should be glad if, in sufficient time beforehand, you would be kind enough to tell me your opinion with regard to a second edition, and whether it would be advisable to renew it in the present form, or to have one much smaller and cheaper.

I have also to thank you for ‘[The Plurality of Worlds](other_books/otherbook_179.qmd)’, I had seen the first edition of that remarkable book but I am very glad to possess this with the additional matter at the commencement.

I suppose 400 pages will not make the volumes too large. I do not know whether the printer has taken into account that most of the latter part of the M S is written less closely than the earlier portions

Yours faithfully
C M Yonge
